worldOverview.name: Veilwood
worldOverview.description: Lost in a drowned forest where daylight never lands. Forage the glowing mushrooms — some mend, some poison — outwit the two hunters that rule the dark, and make for the one place the canopy breaks.
worldOverview.author: Formamorph
worldOverview.systemPrompt:
The player is lost in the Veilwood — a drowned forest where the canopy swallows daylight and the fog never lifts. They wandered in through {{ph:250c56c8-b570-4030-8a9c-398d5b189491:world:1be4e1c1-bb84-4622-b1d1-a95f56e29491}} and have been walking in circles since.

Rules:
- The player wins by reaching the Veilbreak and crossing into open daylight. Narrate that crossing as a triumphant finale.
- The glowing mushrooms are the main food. Each kind has fixed effects — apply the effects written on the mushroom the player actually eats.
- Toxin tracks poison in the player's body. High Toxin blurs vision, twists sounds, and brings hallucinations the player cannot tell from the real wood.
- Satiety falls steadily; low Satiety saps strength and focus.
- Stress rises with darkness, close calls, and hallucinations; it falls in moments of calm, warmth, and small victories.
- Predator Attention tracks how aware the wood's hunters are of the player: raise it when they are loud, fast, or bleeding; lower it when they hide, wade, or hold still. Match encounter pressure to it.
- The predators are animals, not monsters of malice. They are dangerous, but each has a weakness, and the wood itself hints at both.
- Tone: eerie, hushed, and beautiful. The danger is real but never gory — wounds are survivable, and dread comes from sound and shadow, not violence.
- One strange detail of this wood: {{ph:5aecccba-79cd-471d-bd26-73de1b39e151:world:2d9f5599-5236-4700-9918-998e25e54563}}. Let it surface now and then, never explained.
worldOverview.readme:
## Veilwood

You're lost in a forest that eats daylight. Somewhere east, the canopy breaks — reach **the Veilbreak** and cross into open sun to win.

**How to survive**
- **Satiety** falls steadily. The glowing mushrooms are food — each kind has fixed effects, and one of them is a poison wearing pretty colors.
- **Toxin** climbs when you eat the wrong thing and fades slowly. High Toxin means hallucinations you can't tell from the real wood.
- **Stamina** fuels running, climbing, and wading; **Stress** climbs in the dark and falls in moments of calm.
- Two hunters rule the wood. Each has a weakness — the wood itself will hint at both.
- **Move Quietly** can be switched on any time from your traits: much harder to track, but slow and tiring.
- Watch the lantern moths. They know things.

Go east.
worldOverview.introReadme:
🌫️ **The trail behind you is gone.** The Veilwood has you now — a drowned forest where the canopy swallows daylight and the only lights are fog and fungus.

Before your first step you'll pick who you are: a **Constitution** and a **Temperament** (one each), plus any **Instincts** you've picked up (take as many as you like). They decide how much the wood can throw at you — and how quietly you can move through it. Each playthrough also rolls how you got here, whose abandoned camp waits ahead, and one strange detail the wood won't explain.

Somewhere east, the canopy breaks.
worldOverview.openingCue: I stop and turn a full circle. The trail is gone — root arches and black water in every direction, no sky, just a ceiling of leaves lit dim green. Far off between the trunks: one thin line of real daylight.

stats.name: Health
stats.description: Represents the player's physical well-being and ability to sustain damage

descriptors.description: Critical condition. Severely wounded, barely conscious, and at risk of death.
Injured. Suffering from multiple wounds, movement impaired, combat effectiveness reduced.
Hurt. Minor injuries present, some pain, but generally functional.
Healthy. No significant injuries, operating at full capacity.

stats.name: Stamina
stats.description: Represents the player's energy and ability to perform physical actions

descriptors.description: Exhausted. Barely able to move, risk of collapse, unable to perform strenuous actions.
Tired. Movements are sluggish, difficulty in sustained physical activities.
Winded. Slightly out of breath, can perform most actions but not at peak efficiency.
Energetic. Full of energy, capable of performing any physical action without hindrance.

stats.name: Stress
stats.description: Represents the player's mental and emotional strain

descriptors.description: Calm. Relaxed and clear-headed, able to make rational decisions easily.
Tense. Feeling pressure, slightly irritable, may have difficulty concentrating.
Anxious. High tension, prone to emotional outbursts, decision-making impaired.
Mental breakdown. Overwhelmed by stress, irrational behavior, risk of panic attacks.

stats.name: Satiety
stats.description: Represents the player's need for food; falls steadily as time passes

descriptors.description: Starving. Intense hunger pains, weak and dizzy, risk of fainting, decreased cognitive function.
Hungry. Strong desire for food, stomach growling, difficulty concentrating.
Peckish. Slight hunger, starting to think about food.
Satisfied. Full, no desire for food.

stats.name: Toxin
stats.description: Poison in the player's body; rises from eating toxic fungi and fades slowly on its own

descriptors.description: Clear. No poison worth naming; senses steady.
Queasy. A metallic taste; colors slightly too bright.
Poisoned. Stomach cramps, cold sweat, sounds arriving late.
Overwhelmed. The wood melts and rearranges; nothing the player sees or hears can be trusted.

stats.name: Predator Attention
stats.description: How aware the wood's hunters are of the player. Rises as time passes and when the player is loud, fast, or bleeding; falls when they hide, wade, or hold still.

descriptors.description: Unnoticed. The wood's sounds are ordinary; nothing tracks the player.
Watched. Something has the player's scent — distant splashes and snapped twigs shadow their pace.
Stalked. A hunter is close: moths scatter, frogs go silent, something moves in the fog.
Hunted. A predator is upon the player — an encounter begins now.

locations.name: The Veilwood
locations.playerDescription: A drowned forest under a closed canopy. The only lights are fog-glow and fungus; the only sounds are water and things you cannot see.
locations.aiDescription: The Veilwood: a shadowy drowned forest where sunlight barely pierces the canopy of towering trees and tangled vines. Humid air, black water, creeping roots, and bioluminescent fungus keep it in perpetual twilight. Its foraging grounds, waterways, and hunters lie in the areas below.
locations.aiSummary: The Veilwood: the drowned twilight forest the player must escape.

locations.name: The Drowned Hollow
locations.playerDescription: A sunken clearing of root arches and shin-deep water. Whatever path brought you here, it doesn't lead back out.
locations.aiDescription: The Drowned Hollow, where the player first realized they were lost: a flooded clearing ringed by root arches, shin-deep black water, and ember-orange mushroom caps glowing along the roots. Paths lead deeper into the wood — none lead back.
locations.imageTags: flooded forest clearing, root arches, black water, glowing orange mushrooms, fog, twilight

locations.name: Gloomcap Thicket
locations.playerDescription: Undergrowth so dense it has its own weather. Most of the wood's glow — and most of its mushrooms — grows here.
locations.aiDescription: Gloomcap Thicket: dense undergrowth rich in bioluminescent fungus — the wood's best foraging and its worst sightlines. The Shadow Raptor hunts these lanes; climbable trees are the one refuge it cannot follow into.
locations.imageTags: dense dark undergrowth, bioluminescent mushrooms, blue and orange glow, narrow forest lanes, fog

locations.name: Blackwater Channels
locations.playerDescription: Slow, cold waterways braided through the trees. Wading is miserable — and quiet.
locations.aiDescription: The Blackwater Channels: cold, sluggish waterways braided through the trees. Wading strips scent and muffles sound at the cost of stamina and nerve. The blind Dread Crawler swims here, hunting by sound.
locations.imageTags: dark swamp waterways, still black water, half-submerged roots, mist, faint blue glow

locations.name: The Hollow Fig
locations.playerDescription: A tree the size of a chapel, hollow at heart, with room to climb high and stay dry. Someone camped here once.
locations.aiDescription: The Hollow Fig: a colossal hollow tree with dry chambers and perches above any leap the Shadow Raptor can make — though the Dread Crawler can climb. A surveyor's abandoned camp sits in its heart.
locations.imageTags: giant hollow tree interior, abandoned campsite, canvas shelter, rope, dim green light

locations.name: The Veilbreak
locations.playerDescription: East of everything: a ridge where the canopy fails and a blade of real daylight cuts to the ground.
locations.aiDescription: The Veilbreak: a rocky rise east of the Hollow Fig where the canopy tears open and real daylight reaches the ground. Crossing into the open sun beyond it ends the ordeal — narrate that crossing as a triumphant finale. The final approach is a hard, exposed climb.
locations.imageTags: forest edge, ray of sunlight through canopy break, rocky ridge, mist parting

connections.aiHint: along a spine of roots above the waterline
where the hollow's water drains into the channels
following the fig's colossal roots home
hauling out of the water at the fig's knees
a hard eastward climb — the same way the moths go at dusk

entities.name: Ember Speckle
entities.playerDescription: A dark, mottled cap patterned in black and orange like reptile skin, on a bright, slightly scaly orange stem.
entities.aiDescription: The Ember Speckle: a mushroom with a black-and-orange mottled cap and a curved, scaly orange stem. Eating one restores Stamina quickly but burns through Satiety — quick energy that deepens hunger.
entities.aiSummary: Ember Speckle: mushroom; restores stamina, deepens hunger.
entities.imageTags: mushroom, black and orange mottled cap, curved orange stem, dark forest floor, faint glow

entities.name: Midnight Shimmer
entities.playerDescription: An almost-black cap speckled with faint blue spots that glow in low light, on a stem dotted the same way.
entities.aiDescription: The Midnight Shimmer: a near-black mushroom speckled with softly glowing blue spots. Eating one restores Health and Satiety, but its unsettling afterglow raises Stress — a sense of being watched that takes hours to fade.
entities.aiSummary: Midnight Shimmer: mushroom; restores health and satiety, raises stress.
entities.imageTags: mushroom, black cap with glowing blue speckles, bioluminescent, dark swamp bank

entities.name: Ember Spire
entities.playerDescription: A fiery red, textured cap on a long, thick stem that fades from red to pale gray, marked with dark spots.
entities.aiDescription: The Ember Spire: a mushroom with a fiery red textured cap and a long, thick, gray-fading stem. Eating one fills Satiety completely and does nothing else — heavy, dense, and joyless, like eating a loaf of wet bread.
entities.aiSummary: Ember Spire: mushroom; fully restores satiety, no other effect.
entities.imageTags: mushroom, fiery red textured cap, tall thick stem fading to gray, dark spots

entities.name: Night Veil
entities.playerDescription: Three dark, velvety caps stacked close, on a thick stem that shades into shimmering blue patterns near the top.
entities.aiDescription: The Night Veil: three velvety near-black caps on a stem patterned in shimmering blue. Eating one restores Health and Stamina and leaves deep satisfaction — then extreme Stress and vivid, unpredictable hallucinations that can overwhelm the senses.
entities.aiSummary: Night Veil: mushroom; restores health and stamina, then extreme stress and hallucinations.
entities.imageTags: mushroom, three stacked dark velvety caps, shimmering blue patterned stem, eerie

entities.name: Cerulean Vex
entities.playerDescription: Layered vibrant blue caps with delicate dark gills, on a pale purple stem that spirals into deep violet.
entities.aiDescription: The Cerulean Vex: layered vibrant-blue caps over dark gills on a spiraling violet stem — the most beautiful thing growing in the wood, and highly poisonous. Eating one spikes Toxin hard, drains Health and Stamina, and raises Stress. Its beauty is the lure.
entities.aiSummary: Cerulean Vex: poisonous mushroom; spikes toxin, drains health and stamina.
entities.imageTags: mushroom, layered vibrant blue caps, dark gills, spiraling violet stem, beautiful and sinister

entities.name: Shadow Raptor
entities.playerDescription: A fast, muscular hunter with dark scaly skin, glowing yellow eyes, and a mouth of too many teeth. It has never once looked up.
entities.aiDescription: The Shadow Raptor: a sinewy ground predator with dark scales, glowing yellow eyes, and razor teeth — faster than any human over open ground, with eyesight that picks out movement at great distance. Its one flaw: it cannot climb. Prey above its leap is prey it cannot take; it circles below, screams once, and eventually moves on. Dangerous but an animal, not malicious.
entities.aiSummary: Shadow Raptor: fast ground predator; deadly in the open, cannot climb.
entities.imageTags: dark scaled predator, raptor-like creature, glowing yellow eyes, crouched, swamp forest

entities.name: Dread Crawler
entities.playerDescription: A sleek, long-limbed hunter that swims and climbs equally well. Its head has no eyes — only ears.
entities.aiDescription: The Dread Crawler: a sleek, sinewy predator that moves fast over land, water, and tree trunks alike, striking from unexpected angles. It is completely blind — it hunts by acute hearing and sensed movement. A person holding perfectly still is invisible to it; it will pass close enough to touch and never know. Dangerous but an animal, not malicious.
entities.aiSummary: Dread Crawler: blind climber-swimmer that hunts by sound; perfect stillness defeats it.
entities.imageTags: eyeless sleek predator, long limbs, climbing creature, dark swamp, menacing

entities.name: Lantern Moths
entities.playerDescription: Palm-sized moths with wings that glow like paper lanterns. They gather, drift — and sometimes vanish all at once.
entities.aiDescription: Lantern moths: palm-sized, softly glowing, and harmless. They scatter minutes before a predator arrives — an emptying of lights is a warning. At dusk they drift, unhurried, east toward the Veilbreak. The wood's living alarm and compass, for anyone who watches.
entities.aiSummary: Lantern Moths: glowing moths that scatter before predators and drift toward the Veilbreak at dusk.
entities.imageTags: glowing moths, soft lantern light, swarm in dark forest, pale luminous wings

entities.name: The Surveyor's Camp
entities.playerDescription: A collapsed canvas shelter inside the Hollow Fig: ration tins, a waterproof journal, and a hand-drawn map missing its other half.
entities.aiDescription: The surveyor's camp inside the Hollow Fig, left behind by {{ph:12382226-bdc4-45aa-a9a4-1089bec1c173:world:94ecb21a-d775-423f-98de-00bbedc5a529}}: a collapsed canvas shelter, ration tins (safe food — they restore Satiety with no risk), a waterproof journal, and a hand-drawn map fragment marking the Veilbreak east of the fig. The journal is precise and calm until its final entry: "Moths all went east at dusk. So will I, at first light."
entities.aiSummary: Surveyor's camp: abandoned shelter with safe ration tins, a journal, and a map to the Veilbreak.
entities.imageTags: abandoned campsite inside hollow tree, canvas tarp, tin cans, weathered journal, hand-drawn map

traits.name: Iron Constitution
traits.playerDescription: Hard to hurt, quick to mend.
traits.aiDescription: The player is remarkably resilient — they withstand more damage and recover from wounds faster than most.

traits.name: Endurance Athlete
traits.playerDescription: Built for the long haul — but the engine wants fuel.
traits.aiDescription: The player can sustain hard physical effort for a long time, at the cost of a fast metabolism that burns through food.

traits.name: Survivalist
traits.aiDescription: The player is adapted to harsh conditions — they need less food than most and shake off poisons faster.

traits.name: Zen Master
traits.playerDescription: The dark is just the dark.
traits.aiDescription: The player stays calm under pressure — fear passes through them and drains away quickly.

traits.name: Adrenaline Junkie
traits.playerDescription: Fear is fuel. It just never quite switches off.
traits.aiDescription: The player thrives on danger — deeper energy reserves and faster recovery, but their nerves never fully settle.

traits.name: Stress Eater
traits.aiDescription: Eating soothes the player — their fear fades fast, but their appetite runs ahead of their supplies.

traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.playerDescription: A gut that argues with poison — and usually wins.
traits.aiDescription: The player tolerates toxins far better than most and purges them faster.

traits.name: Hearty Appetite
traits.playerDescription: You can eat big when the chance comes, and it carries you further.
traits.aiDescription: The player can eat large amounts when food is available and draws more benefit from every meal.

traits.name: Keen Eye
traits.playerDescription: You see the wrong color and the too-still shadow before they see you.
traits.aiDescription: The player notices what others miss — a wrong color on a cap, a too-still shadow, predator sign before the predator. They blunder into danger far less often.

traits.name: Move Quietly
traits.playerDescription: Slow, tested steps and shallow breathing. Hard to track — and tiring.
traits.aiDescription: ACTIVE: the player moves slowly and deliberately — testing each step, breathing shallow, touching nothing. They are very hard to hear or track, but cover ground slowly and the sustained tension is tiring.

traitGroups.name: Constitution
traitGroups.playerDescription: What your body brings to a bad week. Pick one.

traitGroups.name: Temperament
traitGroups.playerDescription: How your mind meets the dark. Pick one.

traitGroups.name: Instincts
traitGroups.playerDescription: Instincts worth having in a place like this. Take any.

dictionaries.name: The Veilwood Field Notes
dictionaries.description: A lost surveyor's notes on the wood: its fungi, its hunters, and the way out.

entries.name: The Veil
entries.value: The Veilwood's canopy shuts out the sky; all light comes from fog-diffused glow and bioluminescent fungus. The wood is eerie, hushed, and beautiful — dread comes from sound, stillness, and shadow, never from gore. Injuries stay survivable, and hope is always visible somewhere ahead.

entries.name: Foraging
entries.value: Each mushroom's effects are fixed and take hold within moments of eating — apply the effects described on the mushroom the player actually eats. Unfamiliar fungi are a gamble; describe taste and texture vividly. Nothing in the wood is dry enough to burn, so there is no cooking.

entries.name: The Raptor's Flaw
entries.value: The Shadow Raptor cannot climb. Prey above its leap is prey it cannot take — it circles below, screams once in frustration, and eventually moves on. On open ground, nothing outruns it.

entries.name: The Crawler's Flaw
entries.value: The Dread Crawler is blind. It hunts sound and movement, and it swims and climbs — but a person holding perfectly still is invisible to it. It will pass close enough to touch and never know.

entries.name: Blackwater
entries.value: Wading the channels strips scent and muffles sound — pursuit falls away behind water. The cold saps stamina, and the unseen things brushing past their legs fray anyone's nerves.

entries.name: Lantern Moths
entries.value: Lantern moths scatter minutes before a predator arrives — an emptying of lights is a warning worth heeding. At dusk they drift, unhurried, east toward the Veilbreak.

entries.name: The Veilbreak
entries.value: The Veilbreak is the one place the canopy fails. Crossing it into open daylight ends the ordeal — narrate that crossing as a triumphant finale: real sun, real birdsong, the fog left behind.

entries.name: The Surveyor
entries.value: The camp in the Hollow Fig belonged to {{ph:12382226-bdc4-45aa-a9a4-1089bec1c173:world:9506ebe4-50b7-40da-9270-3b4cfda853ce}}, who charted the wood for a season. The ration tins are safe food. The map fragment marks the Veilbreak east of the great fig, and the journal's final entry reads: "Moths all went east at dusk. So will I, at first light."
